abilities.name: Voice Of Command
abilities.text:
If your Army Faction is **^^Astra Militarum^^**, **^^Officer^^** models with this ability can issue Orders. Each **^^Officer^^**'s datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue and which units are eligible to receive those Orders. Each time an **^^Officer^^** model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that **^^Officer^^** model to issue it to. **^^Officer^^** models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a **^^Transport^^** or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that Order. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.


Only **^^Astra Militarum^^** models gain the benefit of an Order issued to their unit.

**MOVE! MOVE! MOVE!**
Add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

**FIX BAYONETS!**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE AIM!**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE!**
Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE COVER!**
Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model’s Save to better than 3+).

**DUTY AND HONOUR!**
Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

abilities.name: Emplacement Platform
abilities.text: Friendly **^^Astra Militarum Infantry**^^ models can be set up or end any type of move on top of the platform section of this **^^Fortification^^**.

abilities.name: Reinforced Cover
abilities.text: Each time a ranged attack is allocated to a model, if that model is not fully visible to every model in the attacking unit because of this **^^Fortification^^**, that model has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

abilities.name: Defence Line
abilities.text: While an **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** model has the Benefit of Cover as a result of this terrain feature, that model has a 4+ invulnerable save

abilities.name: Deployment
abilities.text: When this model is set up, it will consist of 1 platform section, up to 5 shield sections, up to 2 broken shield sections and up to 2 end sections. All sections must be connected to each other to form a continuous defence line; the 2 broken shield sections can be placed either at the end of the defence line, or in the middle of it such that both are within ½" of each other (in this case, these 2 sections count as being connected to each other). All of the sections that have been set up are then treated as a single model for all rules purposes.

abilities.name: Mobile Hunter-killers

abilities.name: Sacrificus Tempestus
abilities.text: **^^Tempestus Scions^^** unit only. abilities.name: Steel Armorial
abilities.text: **^^Astra Militarum Vehicle^^** or **^^Astra Militarum Tech-Priest Enginseer^^** unit only. abilities.text: **^^Regiment^^** unit only. Once per battle, at the start of your opponent's Fight phase, this unit can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, this unit has the Fights First ability.

abilities.name: Honourifica Imperialis
abilities.text: In an Order is issued to this unit, instead of applying until the start of your next Command phase, that Order will apply to it until the end of the battle, until a new Order is issued to it or until that unit becomes Battle-shocked (whichever happens first).

abilities.name: Auramite Aquila

abilities.name: Oculus Laureate
abilities.text: **^^Officer^^** unit only. If this unit is your **^^Warlord^^**, you can use one Crusade Blessing even if you are not the Underdog.

abilities.name: Medallion Resolute
abilities.text: While the unit is within range of an Objective marker that you control, models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

abilities.name: Death Mask of Ollanius

abilities.text: **^^Officer^^** model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, if that unit Remained Stationary this turn, a Critical Hit is scored on a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

abilities.name: Reactive Command
abilities.text: **^^Officer^^** model only. Each time an enemy unit is set up within 8" of the bearer's unit, the bearer can issue one Order. This is not counted towards the number of Orders the bearer can issue each battle round.

abilities.name: Grand Strategist
abilities.text: **^^Officer^^** model only. In your Command phase, the bearer can issue one additional Order.

abilities.name: Bombast-class Vox-array
abilities.text: **MILITARUM TEMPESTUS OFFICER** model only. When this model issues an **Order**, if this unit has the **Master Vox** wargear ability, this model can issue that **Order** to up to three different **REGIMENT** units, instead of only one.

abilities.name: Priority-drop Beacon
abilities.text: **MILITARUM TEMPESTUS OFFICER** model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an **ingress move**.

abilities.name: Eager Advance
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. While the bearer is leading a **^^Regiment^^** unit, that unit has the Scouts 6" ability.

abilities.name: Flash Grenades
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

abilities.name: Stalwart's Honours

abilities.name: Legacy Sidearm
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristics of the bearer's Pistols.

abilities.name: Bold Leadership
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. abilities.name: Sacred Unguents
abilities.text: **^^Astra Militarum Tech-Priest Enginseer^^** model only. abilities.name: Vanguard Honours
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. The bearer's unit can disembark from a **^^Transport^^** after it has Advanced. abilities.name: Smoke Grenades
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. The bearer's unit has the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability while the bearer's unit is wholly within 3" of one or more friendly **^^Transport^^** models.

abilities.name: Indomitable Steed
abilities.text: **^^Vehicle Officer^^** model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

abilities.name: Calm Under Fire
abilities.text: **^^Vehicle Officer^^** model only. Once per turn, after the bearer issues an Order to a **^^Squadron^^** unit from your army, it can issue the same Order to another **^^Squadron^^** unit from your army.

abilities.name: Veteran Crew
abilities.text: **^^Vehicle Officer^^** model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

abilities.name: Regimental Banner
abilities.text: **^^Vehicle Officer^^** model only. Add 3 to the bearer's Objective Control characteristic.

abilities.name: Guerrilla Honours

abilities.name: Survival Gear

abilities.name: Voice Of Command
abilities.text:
If your Army Faction is **^^Astra Militarum^^**, **^^Officer^^** models with this ability can issue Orders. Each **^^Officer^^**'s datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue and which units are eligible to receive those Orders. Each time an **^^Officer^^** model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that **^^Officer^^** model to issue it to. **^^Officer^^** models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a **^^Transport^^** or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that Order. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.


Only **^^Astra Militarum^^** models gain the benefit of an Order issued to their unit.

**MOVE! MOVE! MOVE!**
Add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

**FIX BAYONETS!**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE AIM!**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE!**
Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE COVER!**
Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model’s Save to better than 3+).

**DUTY AND HONOUR!**
Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

abilities.name: Voice Of Command
abilities.text:
If your Army Faction is **^^Astra Militarum^^**, **^^Officer^^** models with this ability can issue Orders. Each **^^Officer^^**'s datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue and which units are eligible to receive those Orders. Each time an **^^Officer^^** model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that **^^Officer^^** model to issue it to. **^^Officer^^** models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a **^^Transport^^** or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that Order. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.


Only **^^Astra Militarum^^** models gain the benefit of an Order issued to their unit.

**MOVE! MOVE! MOVE!**
Add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

**FIX BAYONETS!**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE AIM!**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE!**
Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE COVER!**
Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model’s Save to better than 3+).

**DUTY AND HONOUR!**
Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

abilities.name: Voice Of Command
abilities.text:
If your Army Faction is **^^Astra Militarum^^**, **^^Officer^^** models with this ability can issue Orders. Each **^^Officer^^**'s datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue and which units are eligible to receive those Orders. Each time an **^^Officer^^** model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that **^^Officer^^** model to issue it to. **^^Officer^^** models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a **^^Transport^^** or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that Order. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.


Only **^^Astra Militarum^^** models gain the benefit of an Order issued to their unit.

**MOVE! MOVE! MOVE!**
Add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

**FIX BAYONETS!**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE AIM!**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE!**
Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE COVER!**
Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model’s Save to better than 3+).

**DUTY AND HONOUR!**
Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE AIM!**

Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model’s Save to better than 3+).

**DUTY AND HONOUR!**
Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

abilities.text: **^^Astra Militarum Tech‑Priest Enginseer^^** model only. Each time the bearer uses its Omnissiah’s Blessing ability, until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Move characteristic of the selected Vehicle model.

abilities.name: Omnissian Unguents (Aura)

abilities.name: Exemplary Officer
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. Each time the bearer issues an Order to its own unit, you can select up to two other **^^Platoon^^** units within 3" of the bearer’s unit. That Order is also issued to each of those units.

abilities.name: Master Manoeuvrist
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. abilities.name: Damaged: 1-8 Wounds Remaining
abilities.text: While this model has 1-8 wounds remaining, subtract 4 from its Objective Control characteristic and each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Flush Them Out
abilities.text: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy unit that was hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, that unit is scattered. While a unit is scattered, it cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

abilities.name: Sacrificus Tempestus
abilities.text: **^^Tempestus Scions^^** unit only. abilities.name: Steel Armorial
abilities.text: **^^Astra Militarum Vehicle^^** or **^^Astra Militarum Tech-Priest Enginseer^^** unit only. abilities.name: Bastion Honour
abilities.text: **^^Regiment^^** unit only. Once per battle, at the start of your opponent's Fight phase, this unit can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, this unit has the Fights First ability.

abilities.name: Honourifica Imperialis

abilities.name: Voice Of Command
abilities.text:
If your Army Faction is **^^Astra Militarum^^**, **^^Officer^^** models with this ability can issue Orders. Each **^^Officer^^**'s datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue and which units are eligible to receive those Orders. Each time an **^^Officer^^** model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that **^^Officer^^** model to issue it to. **^^Officer^^** models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a **^^Transport^^** or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that Order. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.


Only **^^Astra Militarum^^** models gain the benefit of an Order issued to their unit.

**MOVE! MOVE! MOVE!**
Add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

**FIX BAYONETS!**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE AIM!**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE!**
Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE COVER!**
Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model’s Save to better than 3+).

**DUTY AND HONOUR!**
Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

abilities.name: Voice Of Command
abilities.text:
If your Army Faction is **^^Astra Militarum^^**, **^^Officer^^** models with this ability can issue Orders. Each **^^Officer^^**'s datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue and which units are eligible to receive those Orders. Each time an **^^Officer^^** model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that **^^Officer^^** model to issue it to. **^^Officer^^** models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a **^^Transport^^** or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that Order. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.


Only **^^Astra Militarum^^** models gain the benefit of an Order issued to their unit.

**MOVE! MOVE! MOVE!**
Add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

**FIX BAYONETS!**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE AIM!**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE!**
Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE COVER!**
Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model’s Save to better than 3+).

**DUTY AND HONOUR!**
Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

If your Army Faction is **^^Astra Militarum^^**, **^^Officer^^** models with this ability can issue Orders. Each **^^Officer^^**'s datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue and which units are eligible to receive those Orders. Each time an **^^Officer^^** model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that **^^Officer^^** model to issue it to. **^^Officer^^** models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a **^^Transport^^** or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that Order. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.


Only **^^Astra Militarum^^** models gain the benefit of an Order issued to their unit.

**MOVE! MOVE! MOVE!**
Add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

**FIX BAYONETS!**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE AIM!**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE!**
Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE COVER!**
Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model’s Save to better than 3+).

**DUTY AND HONOUR!**
Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

abilities.name: Voice Of Command
abilities.text:
If your Army Faction is **^^Astra Militarum^^**, **^^Officer^^** models with this ability can issue Orders. Each **^^Officer^^**'s datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue and which units are eligible to receive those Orders. Each time an **^^Officer^^** model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that **^^Officer^^** model to issue it to. **^^Officer^^** models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a **^^Transport^^** or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that Order. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.


Only **^^Astra Militarum^^** models gain the benefit of an Order issued to their unit.

**MOVE! MOVE! MOVE!**
Add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

**FIX BAYONETS!**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE AIM!**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE!**
Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE COVER!**
Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model’s Save to better than 3+).

**DUTY AND HONOUR!**
Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

abilities.name: Voice Of Command
abilities.text:
If your Army Faction is **^^Astra Militarum^^**, **^^Officer^^** models with this ability can issue Orders. Each **^^Officer^^**'s datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue and which units are eligible to receive those Orders. Each time an **^^Officer^^** model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that **^^Officer^^** model to issue it to. **^^Officer^^** models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a **^^Transport^^** or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that Order. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.


Only **^^Astra Militarum^^** models gain the benefit of an Order issued to their unit.

**MOVE! MOVE! MOVE!**
Add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

**FIX BAYONETS!**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE AIM!**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE!**
Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE COVER!**
Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model’s Save to better than 3+).

**DUTY AND HONOUR!**
Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

abilities.name: Voice Of Command
abilities.text:
If your Army Faction is **^^Astra Militarum^^**, **^^Officer^^** models with this ability can issue Orders. Each **^^Officer^^**'s datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue and which units are eligible to receive those Orders. Each time an **^^Officer^^** model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that **^^Officer^^** model to issue it to. **^^Officer^^** models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a **^^Transport^^** or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that Order. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.


Only **^^Astra Militarum^^** models gain the benefit of an Order issued to their unit.

**MOVE! MOVE! MOVE!**
Add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

**FIX BAYONETS!**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE AIM!**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE!**
Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE COVER!**
Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model’s Save to better than 3+).

**DUTY AND HONOUR!**
Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

If you control an objective marker at the end of your Command phase, and the bearer's unit (or any **^^Transport^^** it is embarked within) is within range of that objective marker, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

abilities.name: Sacred Unguents
abilities.text: **^^Astra Militarum Tech-Priest Enginseer^^** model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one **^^Transport^^** from your army (excluding **^^Aircraft^^** and **^^Titanic^^** units) within 3" of the bearer. Until the end of the phase, each time that **^^Transport^^** makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Vanguard Honours
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. The bearer's unit can disembark from a **^^Transport^^** after it has Advanced. If it does, it counts as having made a Normal move that phase, and cannot declare a charge in the same turn, but can otherwise act normally in the remainder of the turn.

abilities.name: Smoke Grenades
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. The bearer's unit has the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability while the bearer's unit is wholly within 3" of one or more friendly **^^Transport^^** models.

abilities.name: Indomitable Steed
abilities.text: **^^Vehicle Officer^^** model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

abilities.name: Calm Under Fire
abilities.text: **^^Vehicle Officer^^** model only. Once per turn, after the bearer issues an Order to a **^^Squadron^^** unit from your army, it can issue the same Order to another **^^Squadron^^** unit from your army.

abilities.name: Veteran Crew
abilities.text: **^^Vehicle Officer^^** model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

abilities.name: Regimental Banner
abilities.text: **^^Vehicle Officer^^** model only. Add 3 to the bearer's Objective Control characteristic.

abilities.name: Guerrilla Honours
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. After both players have deployed their armies, if the bearer is on the battlefield, select up to three other **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

abilities.name: Scare Gas Grenades
abilities.text: **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** model only. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one enemy unit within 8" of the bearer's unit (excluding **^^Monster^^** and **^^Vehicle^^** units); that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

abilities.name: Tripwires
abilities.text: **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** model only. Each time an enemy **^^Infantry^^** or **^^Mounted^^** unit ends a Normal, Advance, Charge, or Fall Back move within 8" of the bearer's unit, roll a D6; on a 4+, until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is stunned. While a unit is stunned, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Survival Gear
abilities.text: **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** model only. The bearer has the Scouts 6" ability.

abilities.name: Abhuman Detail
abilities.text:
**^^Commissar^^** model only. Add the **^^Ogryn^^** keyword to the list of units this model can issue Orders too (as stated on its datasheet).

In the Declare Battle Formations step, the bearer can be attached to an **^^Ogryn Squad^^** or **^^Bullgryn squad^^** unit.

abilities.name: Aquilan Eye
abilities.text:
**^^Astra Militarum Officer^^** model only. Each time you select an Order for the bearer to issue, you can select the Order below:

**Target Weak Spot (Order):** Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit within 12", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

abilities.name: Laud Hailer
abilities.text: **^^Astra Militarum Officer^^** model only. Each time you select a unit for this **^^Officer^^** model to issue an Order to, that unit can be within 12" instead of within 6".

abilities.name: Spec Ops Veteran
abilities.text:
**^^Astra Militarum Infantry Officer^^** model only. Each time you select an Order for the bearer to issue, you can select the Order below:

**Move to the Shadows (Order):** Each time a ranged attack targets this unit, until those attacks are resolved, models in this unit have the Stealth ability.

abilities.name: Rigged Blind Grenades
abilities.text: Once per battle, when an enemy unit opens a Hatchway, if the bearer is on the battlefield, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, roll one D6: on a 2+, that enemy unit is Battle-shocked.

abilities.name: Shipboard Veteran
abilities.text: Each time you target an **^^Astra Militarum^^** unit from your army with a Stratagem, if that unit is visible to the bearer, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

abilities.name: Covert Breach
abilities.text: At the start of the first battle round, the bearer's unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

abilities.name: Elimination Force
abilities.text: At the start of the first battle round, select one enemy unit. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than the Toughness characteristic of that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Battalion Commander
abilities.text: **^^Astra Militarum Titanic Character^^** model only. The bearer has the Voice of Command ability and the **^^Officer^^** keyword, and can issue up to 2 Orders to **^^Astra Militarum Titanic^^** and **^^Squadron^^** units.

abilities.name: Titan Killer
abilities.text: **^^Astra Militarum Titanic Character^^** model only. Each time the bearer makes a ranged attack, you can re‑roll the Damage roll.

abilities.name: Assault Hatches
abilities.text: **^^Astra Militarum Titanic Character Transport^^** model only. Each time a unit disembarks from the bearer after it has made a Normal move, that unit is still eligible to declare a charge this turn.

abilities.name: Engine Speaker
abilities.text: **^^Astra Militarum Tech‑Priest Enginseer^^** model only. Each time the bearer uses its Omnissiah’s Blessing ability, until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Move characteristic of the selected Vehicle model.

abilities.name: Omnissian Unguents (Aura)
abilities.text: **^^Astra Militarum Tech‑Priest Enginseer^^** model only. While a friendly **^^Armoured Skirmisher^^** unit is within 3" of the bearer, that unit has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

abilities.name: Exemplary Officer
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. Each time the bearer issues an Order to its own unit, you can select up to two other **^^Platoon^^** units within 3" of the bearer’s unit. That Order is also issued to each of those units.

abilities.name: Master Manoeuvrist
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in that unit is within 3" of an **^^Astra Militarum Transport^^** from your army, it can embark within that **^^Transport^^**.

abilities.name: Sentry Programming
abilities.text: You can target this unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already used that Stratagem on a different unit this phase.

abilities.name: Sacrificus Tempestus
abilities.text: **^^Tempestus Scions^^** unit only. If this unit is destroyed while within range of an objective marker that you control, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

abilities.name: Steel Armorial
abilities.text: **^^Astra Militarum Vehicle^^** or **^^Astra Militarum Tech-Priest Enginseer^^** unit only. At the end of the battle, if this unit is part of your Crusade army and was not destroyed during the battle, you can re-roll one failed Out of Action test taken for a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Vehicle^^** unit.

abilities.name: Bastion Honour
abilities.text: **^^Regiment^^** unit only. Once per battle, at the start of your opponent's Fight phase, this unit can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, this unit has the Fights First ability.

abilities.name: Honourifica Imperialis
abilities.text: In an Order is issued to this unit, instead of applying until the start of your next Command phase, that Order will apply to it until the end of the battle, until a new Order is issued to it or until that unit becomes Battle-shocked (whichever happens first).

abilities.name: Celeris Heart
abilities.text: **^^Regiment^^** unit only. Once per turn, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 9" of this unit, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to D6".

abilities.name: Order of the Adamantine Chain
abilities.text: Each time this unit is Marked for Greatness, it gains an additional 2XP.

abilities.name: Merit of the Strategium
abilities.text: After both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy this unit. When doing so, this unit can be placed into Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

abilities.name: Diamantine Star
abilities.text: **^^Regiment^^** unit only. When this unit arrives from Strategic Reserves, it can be set up within your opponent's deployment zone (all other restrictions still apply).

abilities.name: Star of Fidelity
abilities.text: Each time you select this unit as the target of a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

abilities.name: Decree of Dispensation
abilities.text: **^^Officer^^** unit only. Once per Tour of Duty, if this unit is your **^^Warlord^^**, you can select on deficiency effect that current applies to your Crusade force. Until the end of your next battle, that effect does not apply to your Crusade force.

abilities.name: Auxila Golden Star
abilities.text: **^^Cavalry^^** or **^^Ogryn^^** unit only. You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already used that Stratagem on a different unit this phase.

abilities.name: Departmento Salvage Award
abilities.text: **^^Regiment^^** or **^^Ratlings^^** unit only. At the end of the battle, if this unit is on the battlefield, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if this unit is within range of an objective marker that you control. On a 6+, you gain 1 Requisition point.

abilities.name: Laurels of Purity
abilities.text: **^^Officer^^** or **^^Ministorum Priest^^** unit only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic Attacks.

abilities.name: Auramite Aquila
abilities.text: Unit with the Battle-hardened rank or higher only. This unit gains one Battle Trait of your choice. Each time an **^^Officer^^** model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that **^^Officer^^** model to issue it to. **^^Officer^^** models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a **^^Transport^^** or were set up on the battlefield.

Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.


Only **^^Astra Militarum^^** models gain the benefit of an Order issued to their unit.

**MOVE! MOVE! MOVE!**
Add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

**FIX BAYONETS!**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE AIM!**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE!**
Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE COVER!**
Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model’s Save to better than 3+).

**DUTY AND HONOUR!**
Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

abilities.name: Exemplary Officer
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. Each time the bearer issues an Order to its own unit, you can select up to two other **^^Platoon^^** units within 3" of the bearer’s unit. That Order is also issued to each of those units.

abilities.name: Master Manoeuvrist
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. abilities.name: Damaged: 1-7 Wounds Remaining
abilities.text: While this model has 1-7 wounds remaining, subtract 4 from its Objective Control characteristic and each time this model makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Grenadiers
abilities.text: Once per turn, you can target this unit with the Grenade Stratagem for 0CP.

abilities.name: Grenadier Squad
abilities.text: If a model from your army with the Leader ability can be attached to a **^^Krieg Combat Engineers^^** unit, it can be attached to this unit instead.

abilities.name: Sacrificus Tempestus
abilities.text: **^^Tempestus Scions^^** unit only. If this unit is destroyed while within range of an objective marker that you control, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

abilities.name: Steel Armorial
abilities.text: **^^Astra Militarum Vehicle^^** or **^^Astra Militarum Tech-Priest Enginseer^^** unit only. abilities.name: Bastion Honour
abilities.text: **^^Regiment^^** unit only. Once per battle, at the start of your opponent's Fight phase, this unit can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the phase, this unit has the Fights First ability.

abilities.name: Honourifica Imperialis
abilities.text: In an Order is issued to this unit, instead of applying until the start of your next Command phase, that Order will apply to it until the end of the battle, until a new Order is issued to it or until that unit becomes Battle-shocked (whichever happens first).

abilities.name: Celeris Heart

abilities.name: Order of the Adamantine Chain

abilities.name: Voice Of Command
abilities.text:
If your Army Faction is **^^Astra Militarum^^**, **^^Officer^^** models with this ability can issue Orders. Each **^^Officer^^**'s datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue and which units are eligible to receive those Orders. Each time an **^^Officer^^** model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that **^^Officer^^** model to issue it to. **^^Officer^^** models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a **^^Transport^^** or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that Order. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.


Only **^^Astra Militarum^^** models gain the benefit of an Order issued to their unit.

**MOVE! MOVE! MOVE!**
Add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

**FIX BAYONETS!**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE AIM!**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE!**
Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE COVER!**
Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model’s Save to better than 3+).

**DUTY AND HONOUR!**
Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

abilities.name: Regimental Standard

abilities.name: Medi-pack

abilities.name: Death Mask of Ollanius
abilities.text: **^^Officer^^** model only. While the bearer’s unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit, instead of changing it to 0

abilities.name: Drill Commander
abilities.text: **^^Officer^^** model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, if that unit Remained Stationary this turn, a Critical Hit is scored on a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

abilities.name: Reactive Command
abilities.text: **^^Officer^^** model only. Each time an enemy unit is set up within 8" of the bearer's unit, the bearer can issue one Order. This is not counted towards the number of Orders the bearer can issue each battle round.

abilities.name: Grand Strategist
abilities.text: **^^Officer^^** model only. In your Command phase, the bearer can issue one additional Order.

abilities.name: Bombast-class Vox-array

abilities.name: Priority-drop Beacon
abilities.text: **MILITARUM TEMPESTUS OFFICER** model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an **ingress move**.

abilities.name: Eager Advance
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. While the bearer is leading a **^^Regiment^^** unit, that unit has the Scouts 6" ability.

abilities.name: Flash Grenades
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

abilities.name: Stalwart's Honours

abilities.name: Legacy Sidearm
abilities.text: **^^Infantry Officer^^** model only. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristics of the bearer's Pistols.

abilities.name: Bold Leadership

abilities.name: Indomitable Steed

abilities.name: Veteran Crew

abilities.name: Regimental Banner

abilities.name: Voice Of Command
abilities.text:
If your Army Faction is **^^Astra Militarum^^**, **^^Officer^^** models with this ability can issue Orders. Each **^^Officer^^**'s datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue and which units are eligible to receive those Orders. Each time an **^^Officer^^** model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that **^^Officer^^** model to issue it to. **^^Officer^^** models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a **^^Transport^^** or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that Order. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.


Only **^^Astra Militarum^^** models gain the benefit of an Order issued to their unit.

**MOVE! MOVE! MOVE!**
Add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

**FIX BAYONETS!**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE AIM!**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE!**
Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE COVER!**
Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model’s Save to better than 3+).

**DUTY AND HONOUR!**
Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

abilities.name: Voice Of Command
abilities.text:
If your Army Faction is **^^Astra Militarum^^**, **^^Officer^^** models with this ability can issue Orders. Each **^^Officer^^**'s datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue and which units are eligible to receive those Orders. Each time an **^^Officer^^** model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that **^^Officer^^** model to issue it to. **^^Officer^^** models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a **^^Transport^^** or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that Order. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.


Only **^^Astra Militarum^^** models gain the benefit of an Order issued to their unit.

**MOVE! MOVE! MOVE!**
Add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

**FIX BAYONETS!**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE AIM!**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE!**
Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE COVER!**
Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model’s Save to better than 3+).

**DUTY AND HONOUR!**
Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

abilities.name: Voice Of Command
abilities.text:
If your Army Faction is **^^Astra Militarum^^**, **^^Officer^^** models with this ability can issue Orders. Each **^^Officer^^**'s datasheet will specify how many Orders it can issue and which units are eligible to receive those Orders. Each time an **^^Officer^^** model issues an Order, select one of the Orders below, then select one eligible friendly unit within 6" of that **^^Officer^^** model to issue it to. **^^Officer^^** models can issue Orders in your Command phase and at the end of a phase in which they disembarked from a **^^Transport^^** or were set up on the battlefield.

Until the start of your next Command phase, the unit you selected is affected by that Order. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can only be affected by one Order at a time (any Order subsequently issued to that unit replaces the current one). Orders cannot be issued to Battle-shocked units, and if a unit being affected by an Order becomes Battle-shocked, that Order ceases to affect that unit.


Only **^^Astra Militarum^^** models gain the benefit of an Order issued to their unit.

**MOVE! MOVE! MOVE!**
Add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

**FIX BAYONETS!**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE AIM!**
Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE!**
Improve the Attacks characteristic of Rapid Fire weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

**TAKE COVER!**
Improve the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (this cannot improve a model’s Save to better than 3+).

**DUTY AND HONOUR!**
Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1.

abilities.name: Brutal Disciplinarian
abilities.text: Once per turn, at the start of any phase, you can select one friendly **^^Astra Militarum Infantry^^** unit (excluding units that only contain one model) that is Battle‑shocked and within 24" of and visible to this model. If you do, one model in that unit is destroyed, and that unit is no longer Battle‑shocked.

abilities.name: Mechanised Spearhead
abilities.text: In your Movement phase, each time a friendly **^^Astra Militarum Regiment^^** unit disembarks from a **^^Transport^^** that is within 6" of this model, after that unit has been set up, this model can issue 1 Order to that **^^Regiment^^** unit, regardless of how many Orders this model has already issued this turn.

abilities.name: Aquiline Prow
abilities.text: Each time this unit ends a Charge move, you can select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it, then roll one D6: on a 2‑3, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 4‑5, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.

abilities.text: In an Order is issued to this unit, instead of applying until the start of your next Command phase, that Order will apply to it until the end of the battle, until a new Order is issued to it or until that unit becomes Battle-shocked (whichever happens first).
